name: boot-sequence
description: A BIOS-style boot screen when a session starts: real checks of git, toolchains, devices, ports, context and disk, typed out and flipped to OK, WARN or FAIL

animate.title: Animate the boot screen
animate.description: Off shows the finished boot log at once, with no typewriter or scanline effects

collapseSeconds.title: Collapse after (seconds)
collapseSeconds.description: How long the finished boot log stays open above the prompt before it folds into a one-line summary
